body: Source: GitHub issue #876. plugins/adlc-herdr/package.json declares MIT license but had no LICENSE file in plugins/adlc-herdr and omitted LICENSE from the files array. Add plugins/adlc-herdr/LICENSE matching the repository MIT license, include LICENSE in package.json files, and add a regression test in plugins/adlc-herdr/test/manifest.test.mjs.
criteria: plugins/adlc-herdr/LICENSE exists with the MIT license text.
plugins/adlc-herdr/package.json files array includes LICENSE and npm pack --dry-run --json includes LICENSE.
out_of_scope: Other plugin packages that already ship LICENSE.
title: plugin(adlc-herdr): ship LICENSE file in package directory and npm tarball (#876)
